issues.description: Heuristic getCategoryLabel silently mislabels previously-known categories like 'trustboundaries'
issues.detail: The old adapter explicitly mapped 'trustboundaries' to 'Trust Boundaries'. The new heuristic in lib/categories.ts has no such mapping and SPECIAL_CASES is empty, so 'trustboundaries' now renders as 'Trustboundaries'. This is a user-visible regression in the radar, selector, and findings filter. Add it (and any other multi-word IDs) to SPECIAL_CASES.

issues.description: FilterType.CATEGORY may not exist; new filter entry could break findings filter rendering
issues.detail: findings-filters.tsx references FilterType.CATEGORY but the diff doesn't show it being added to the FilterType enum, and the removal of the 'category__in' DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES entry suggests this filter is being routed differently. If CATEGORY is undefined or the badge mapping is missing, the active filter badge for Category will be lost or the filter will not render correctly.

issues.description: Removing category badge config drops user-visible 'Categories filtered' badge
issues.detail: DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES previously rendered the active 'Category' filter chip. The diff removes that entry without showing a replacement. Unless the new filter pipeline injects a badge config from labelFormatter, applied Category filters will no longer surface in the active badge bar, regressing UX consistency with other filters.

issues.description: Duplicate key in SEVERITY_ORDER object literal — 'Informational' and 'Info' both map to 4 with same numeric tier
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 may cause silent collisions when reverse-mapping or rendering legend keys, and conflates two distinct API values. If the backend ever returns both, ordering/grouping logic that relies on uniqueness (or Object.entries iteration) will dedupe incorrectly. Prefer normalizing the input to one canonical name.

issues.description: Version-pattern regex misclassifies legitimate words ending in vN (e.g., 'env1', 'dev2')
issues.detail: formatWord's /^([a-z]+)(v\d+)$/ will turn 'env1' into 'EN v1' style outputs because it matches any letters followed by 'v<digits>'. Unlikely with current category IDs, but the rule is fragile and the comment overstates its safety. Consider anchoring to a known acronym list or requiring a hyphen boundary.

issues.description: getBadgeLabel receives formatted label instead of raw value, may break entity lookups
issues.detail: data-table-filter-custom.tsx now passes displayLabel into getBadgeLabel(entity, displayLabel). If getBadgeLabel internally uses the second argument as a key/identifier (rather than a fallback display string), passing the human-readable label rather than the raw value could break selection state or badge dismissal. Worth confirming getBadgeLabel's contract.

review.summary: The PR cleanly extracts category labeling and adds a useful radar selector + findings filter, but the new heuristic in lib/categories.ts loses the explicit 'Trust Boundaries' mapping and may regress other multi-word IDs. The removal of the 'category__in' DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES entry combined with an unverified FilterType.CATEGORY reference risks breaking the active filter badge on the Findings page. The SEVERITY_ORDER duplicate-value addition (Info/Informational both = 4) is a smell worth normalizing upstream. Overall the changes are sound; a few label-mapping and filter-plumbing details need verification before merge.
